# Incomplete Dependency Resolution

The function for resolving dependencies may fail to find a matching repository if the provided coordinate does not align perfectly with existing mappings. This could lead to untracked or unresolved dependencies in the code base.

- `knowledge_compiler/mcp/queries.py` — `knowledge_compiler.mcp.queries.resolve_dependency`
